newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv to spin off brewing unit.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv to spin off brewing unit.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd said on Thursday it was considering a separate listing of its brewing business on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
Jardine Fleming Securities Ltd has been named as sponsor with Credit Lyonnais Securities (Asia) Ltd as co-sponsor.
"The Stock Exchange has yet to consider the application of the proposed separate listing," Guangdong Investment said in a statement.
It said about 60 percent of the new shares to be offered would be reserved for current Guangdong Investment shareholders. The timing of the listing and other terms had yet to be fixed.
Guangdong Investment shares closed HK$0.05 lower at HK$8.35 on Thursday after rising to a high of HK$8.85 during the session.
